newsitem.title: USA: Carlton says settles suit with TLC Beatrice.
newsitem.headline: Carlton says settles suit with TLC Beatrice.

text.p: Carlton Investments, a partnership composed of former Drexel Burnham Lambert Inc executives, said Friday it settled three related legal disputes with TLC Beatrice International Holdings Inc.

Carlton said the settlement, which had challenged certain compensation and other payments from TLC Beatrice to its former chief executive, Reginald Lewis, requires Lewis's estate to pay back almost $15 million to the company over seven years.
Carlton owns 22 percent of TLC Beatrice, and is its largest shareholder.
On Thursday, TLC Beatrice announced that Carlton had agreed to withdraw its lawsuit.
A Carlton spokesman said it had, indeed, withdrawn the suit through this settlement.
The lawsuit had contested a $22.1 million compensation package paiud to TLC's late CEO before his death in 1993 for five year's service.
Carlton said the settlment was negotiated by an independent committee of TLC Beatrice's directors, and approved by the Deleware Court of Chancery.
